input_messages.content: Hi there! I hope you’re having a good day. And the refund goes back to my gift card, not to my credit card or anything else, correct? Sorry, I just want to make sure I’m not accidentally agreeing to something weird!

Alright, I think that makes sense now! So, yes, please go ahead and start the exchange for me. I’ll keep an eye out for the email with the instructions. Thanks for being so patient with all my questions!
That all sounds good! I’ll watch for the email and follow the steps. Thanks again for helping me sort this out—I know I asked a million questions! Have a great day! ###STOP###
